title: Lab - Multiple schedulers
description: Run a custom scheduler and route a Pod to it.
scenario: Run a custom scheduler and route a Pod to it. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Inspect
tasks.instructions: Which image and which configuration does the default scheduler use?
tasks.solution: kubectl get pod -n kube-system kube-scheduler-controlplane -o jsonpath='{.spec.containers[0].image}'

tasks.title: Task 2 - Deploy a second one
tasks.instructions: Deploy my-scheduler as a Pod in kube-system using the same image and a KubeSchedulerConfiguration with profile name my-scheduler.
tasks.solution: # ConfigMap with the config, Pod mounting it, --config flag

tasks.title: Task 3 - Use it
tasks.instructions: Create Pod nginx with schedulerName my-scheduler and confirm the custom scheduler placed it.
tasks.solution: kubectl get events -o wide | grep Scheduled
